message: S4-ast-taint CMDR 18:34, second commit on the same candidate: drop the predicate I had added alongside `unsourced`. Same condition, so it could never fire - probe P2 (90000 ms in a worker file) is caught by `unsourced` at the older line, which is what the run record attributes. What stays is the one new rule: a file that already asks write_deadline or settings for the wait may state no inline busy_timeout number at any size. Test bytes only; 0 product bytes.
why_a_second_commit: the first candidate is already cited by blob on the shelf; replacing it would leave that citation pointing at nothing, so the removal is a child commit and the branch diff against the base is still one file
